name: Multiplier
summary: US nonprofit that takes on environmental and sustainability projects of regional, national or international reach that can raise $100,000 in their first year.

evidence.quote: Focus on one or more of the following areas: Healthy Planet and People; Sustainable, Equitable Economies; Secure Natural Resources; Resilient Communities.
Upon approval as a Multiplier project, you have immediate access to IRS 501(c)(3) tax exemption
Upon approval as a Multiplier project, you have immediate access to IRS 501(c)(3) tax exemption

projects.value: Healthy planet and people, sustainable economies, natural resources or resilient communities

evidence.quote: Focus on one or more of the following areas: Healthy Planet and People; Sustainable, Equitable Economies; Secure Natural Resources; Resilient Communities.

where.value: Regional, national or international; a local project needs a plan to grow

evidence.quote: A game-changing approach to regional, national or international impact. Or if the project is currently only local in scope, a plan to scale or replicate beyond the local community focus.
competitive project administration fee structure is just 9% of project revenue

fees.value: 14% for government awards, and for restricted funds reported in other currencies

evidence.quote: For government awards/sub-awards and for administration of restricted funds requiring reporting in international currencies, a 14% fee applies.

fees.value: May be negotiable for well-established international NGOs that want a US fundraising home

evidence.quote: Our fee structure may be negotiable for well-established international NGOs seeking a US-based fundraising home.

min_income.value: Strong prospects of raising at least $100,000 in year 1

evidence.quote: Strong prospects for raising at least $100,000 in Year 1 and an achievable fund development plan.
Payroll processing and tax withholding in all states
Not already be a 501(c)(3) organization.

conditions.value: A clear mission, a program plan with a budget, and a funding plan

evidence.quote: Have a well-researched funding plan to raise the money you need for your budget.

conditions.value: Multiplier submits all government grant applications itself

evidence.quote: Quality assurance review and direct submission of all government grants
